about: Transition filters (p:animEffect filter) the viewer does not draw as PowerPoint does: an entrance or exit using one plays as a fade over its duration, then lands on its state. Every other filter in ECMA-376's grammar is drawn. Kept true by pptxMotion.test.ts. README: Played as a fade.

filters.reason: the slide filter's moving copy of the shape is not drawn; PowerPoint's scripting offers no effect that writes it, so no film shows it
